## Knowledge Base

### Purpose

This repository uses the Knowledge Base at [https://github.com/ihcomega56/gh-aw-demo](https://github.com/ihcomega56/gh-aw-demo) on branch `main`.

### Required behavior

1. Before changing code, read `docs/index.md` from that branch.
2. Use the index to open only the knowledge files relevant to the task.
3. If the index is unavailable, stop and report that the Knowledge Base could not be loaded.

### Source of truth

Generated knowledge tracks the code. When the knowledge and code disagree, trust the code and correct the knowledge through the write-back flow.

### Write-back

Write documentation updates back to `ihcomega56/gh-aw-demo`. Keep authored documentation intact, update `docs/index.md` when knowledge files move, and contribute through the rolling Knowledge Base pull request rather than committing to the default branch.
<!-- github-knowledge-base-end -->
